why_nominal_sum_is_not_eligible: Palm Beach contributes 94 units but machine-readable raw observations are not demonstrated.
Hendry/Collier contributes 109 units but the exact machine-readable field-data artifact is unresolved.
Amargosa contributes 54 units but machine-readable current, voltage and error observations are unresolved.
Michigan contributes 93 units but raw observations are only demonstrated as report appendix tables, not machine-readable instrument files.
Barter Island contributes 22 campaign transects but its exact data release is unresolved.
Closely spaced grid transects can be correlated and are not automatically independent.
Several releases do not yet prove ABMN coordinates, current, voltage, polarity and per-observation error.
Different VES and ERT acquisition contracts cannot be pooled without a frozen compatible adapter.
The proven modern/digital candidate subset has only 124 nominal profiles before correlation adjustment and cannot retain 223 sealed test clusters.

unblock_conditions: Resolve official ScienceBase items and central-directory manifests for every retained release.
Prove per-transect raw files contain ABMN geometry, injected current, measured voltage or resistance, polarity and usable error evidence.
Restrict to a common acquisition/units/sign contract or implement and verify an explicit lossless adapter for each family.
Freeze coordinate-level transect identities and eliminate repeat/overlapping grids without using outcomes.
Demonstrate enough total candidates to preserve training, buffer and calibration while retaining 223 sealed test clusters.
Estimate correlation length using training responses only and merge nearby transects before the formal count.
